about: Issues and stances, likes and dislikes (Docs/Design/84 §7.6, §8.8; Phase 6). An issue is something residents hold a view on, spoken of in its `words`, coming up on its `topics` (topics.json's). A resident's stance on it is worked out from their own facts (self.*: their post, class, quarter, temperament, never the moment): each `for` or `against` that holds moves it a step that way, giving its reason (`why`, a key of `reasons`: the words they'd say it in, first person, true of them because its criteria hold). Events move it a step more (`drift`: the game looks for them once a game day and keeps what moved whom in the talk ledger, once each event; at most two steps either way): a theft from them closed unsolved (robbed_uncaught) or charged (robbed_caught), the Restday dole feeding them (fed_by_dole), kin of theirs under a warrant (kin_charged), a wedding of their own (wed); each drift event has a reason of its own. The sum is the stance: for, against, or mixed (as many steps each way, or none), its strength the steps it leans (0-3). Read as self.op.<issue>, self.op_why.<issue> and self.op_strength.<issue>; the pair's pair.agree.<issue> once two have aired it. `who` (criteria) says who has a view at all (a Coldwater fisher has none on the Sump). Likes and dislikes are held for good (until mantles bring their own, drawn from the resident's id among the items whose `when` holds of them): one like of each kind (pastime, food, weather, thing) and two dislikes, read as self.likes / self.dislikes (list facts) and the words of each (self.pastime_words, food_words, weather_words, thing_words; dislike_words, the first).

reasons.guard: I walk with them myself, and I know what the nights are like
reasons.counter: they keep the light paws off my counter
reasons.upper: they keep my street quiet of a night
reasons.sly: they've their noses in everybody's business but their own
reasons.sump: they only come down our way to drag somebody off
reasons.moved_on: they've moved me on from every doorway in this town
reasons.robbed_uncaught: they never caught whoever robbed me
reasons.robbed_caught: they caught the one who robbed me, I'll give them that
reasons.kin_charged: they've my own kin's name up on their board

reasons.upper: this town would fall down without them, and I'd know
reasons.servant: they've kept a roof over my head and bread in my belly
reasons.steady: they keep the works going, and the works keep the rest of us
reasons.lower: I've worked my whole life in their shadow and never once seen their faces
reasons.sump: they own every brick down our way and mend none of them
reasons.ambitious: nobody rises in this town without a House's say-so

reasons.on_it: there are weeks it's the only bread on my table
reasons.warm: nobody in a town this size should go to bed hungry
reasons.devout: feeding the hungry is the Bright One's own work
reasons.rich: I pay for it, and I see who comes back for seconds
reasons.earned: I never took a crumb I didn't earn, and I'm the better for it
reasons.cold: it teaches folk to stand in a queue instead of finding work
reasons.fed_by_dole: it fed my house through a lean week, and I'll not forget it

reasons.restless: I'd be one myself somewhere, if I had the nerve
reasons.warm: there's room enough here for anybody who'll pull their weight
reasons.trade: new faces bring new coin, and I'm not too proud to take it
reasons.nervy: you never know who you're letting in until it's too late
reasons.old: every one that comes makes the place a little less like itself
reasons.work: they take what little work there is going

reasons.devout: the Bright One has kept me through worse than this
reasons.priest: I've served it all my life, and I'd serve it again
reasons.old: I've buried enough folk to be glad somebody says the words
reasons.sly: the plate goes round a good deal faster than the prayers do
reasons.busy: a sermon never once put bread on my table
reasons.fed_by_dole: they fed my house when nobody else would

reasons.merchant: I keep a counter myself, and I know what the wagons cost
reasons.carter: I drive the wagons, and nobody sees what the road takes out of a load
reasons.poor: I can't buy a loaf on what I'm paid, and they never go short
reasons.lower: they put a penny on whenever they think nobody's counting
reasons.frank: half of what they call the price is the merchant's own supper

reasons.born: I was born under its smoke and I'll die under it, gladly
reasons.chance: there's more chance in a week there than in a year anywhere else
reasons.away: it's all smoke and elbows, and nobody knows their neighbour
reasons.nervy: there's a cutpurse on every corner and a cart at every crossing

reasons.carter: the road's my living, and most days it's no worse than it ever was
reasons.restless: a road's a road; you keep your wits and you get where you're going
reasons.guard: we ride them often enough to know where the trouble sits
reasons.nervy: I'd not set a paw on them these days, not for any money
reasons.old: they were safer when I was young, whatever anyone tells you
reasons.merchant: every load that comes in late costs me, and they come in late more and more

reasons.merry: a day of dancing does a body more good than a week of sleep
reasons.chatty: it's the one day the whole town's out and talking
reasons.young: there are sweets and music and nobody sends you to bed
reasons.short: it's all noise and spilt ale, and somebody always ends up crying
reasons.work: it's a day's work lost, and the bills don't take a holiday
reasons.dry: I'd sooner watch it from a quiet window
reasons.wed: I danced at my own wedding and I'll never say a word against a feast again

reasons.trade: good ale is an honest trade and I'll not hear otherwise
reasons.merry: a jar among friends never hurt anybody worth knowing
reasons.devout: I've seen what it does to a family, and so has the Bright One
reasons.healer: I've stitched up enough of its handiwork
reasons.nervy: folk say things in drink they can't take back

reasons.thriving: trade's never been better at my door
reasons.rich: I've no complaints, and I'd be a fool to make any
reasons.content: there's bread on the table and a roof over it, and that's plenty
reasons.poor: it gets a little harder every week, and nobody up there notices
reasons.failing: my counter's emptier every week, and I can't see the bottom yet
reasons.dole: I'm stood in the dole queue, and I never thought I would be

reasons.home: it's home, and folk down there look after their own
reasons.heights: I don't go below the Ropewalk if I can help it
reasons.upper: every trouble in this city starts down there and climbs
reasons.nervy: I'd not walk it after dark, nor before it either

reasons.trade: travellers are half my trade and all my news
reasons.warm: a stranger's only a friend you haven't fed yet
reasons.nervy: you never know what they've left behind them, or what follows
reasons.guarded: I keep my door shut to faces I don't know
reasons.cold: they come, they stare, they go, and somebody's purse goes with them
